statements.t: Based on these results, we are planning a 48-week Phase 2 study in up to 150 subjects with MetALD and ALD, targeted to begin in the second half of 2027.
Her extensive experience developing therapies for metabolic and liver diseases will be particularly valuable as we prepare to move DA-1726 into Phase 2 development in MetALD and ALD.

In parallel, we continue to advance vanoglipel, our G-protein-coupled receptor 119 (GPR119) agonist, in combination with resmetirom for MASH, with a Phase 2a proof-of-concept study targeted to begin in the first half of 2027 ."
